title: The Kuva Wytch/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Dialogue from the The Kuva Wytch mission in Uranus Proxima.
- Ryoku: "Our mission? Humiliation. Find Vena and cut her down to size."
- Ryoku: "I have challenged the butcher Vena to an assassin's duel. Take her to the brink of oblivion. She must know I am her better."
- Ryoku: "This wretched peace. My blade dulls while Vena's ego swells. No more. We will hone our daggers upon her throat. She must be humbled… To preserve the peace."
- Ryoku: "From his perch within Pontis Tower Hunhow watches, eager for a martial contest. Come, let us find Vena, and give the old Sentient what he desires."
- Ryoku: "The butcher lurks in this field of stone and ice, from which her Bloodfrenzy Corpus hew sustenance. Look for the biggest asteroid and crack it open."
- Ryoku: "This asteroid field is the beating heart of Vena's operation. Now it's Vena's turn to bleed. Smash the biggest asteroid and take its ore for our ship."
- Ryoku: "Move into position. Collect the asteroid's spoils."
- Ryoku: "Vena's infested filth has pierced our hull. Cleanse this vessel."
- Latrox Une: "What fortune, I've been marooned here for ages with these infested. I'll gladly help crew this ship in exchange for some pressurized atmosphere."
- Latrox Une: "Tenno? How unlikely to meet you again in an infested asteroid field of all places? May I be so bold as to offer my services?"
- Ryoku: "Turrets ahead. We must hit them first."
- Ryoku: "Turrets. Is this your idea of a trap, Vena. Take them out."
- Ryoku: "Ready forward artillery. Chip that ice away."
- Ryoku: "A fortress of ice? Forward artillery. Target the walls. This siege will not last long."
- Ryoku: "We're in. Spies tell me that Vena has been toying with a very dangerous weapon. Breach that door."
- Ryoku: "A weapon of rare power is hidden within the ice here. It will be ours. Open those doors."
- Ryoku: "Duty calls on us to eliminate all resistance."
- Ryoku: "This one wishes to test themselves against you. Let them try."
- Vena: "Come in. I was expecting you."
- Vena: "Here I am. Come get me."
- Sister of Parvos: "I warn you, I'm a lot stronger than I look!"
- Sister of Parvos: "A Sister of Parvos is an official position. So you see, I'm officially killing you. Perhaps that will be some comfort."
- Sister of Parvos: "Have you met my Hound? A gormless mass of metallized flesh that follows me around everywhere? You two have a lot in common."
- Sister of Parvos: "Look, I am actually going to hurt you quite badly, and it's only fair to let you know that."
- Sister of Parvos: "I'm sorry! It's too late for mediation! You've escalated this situation waaaaay beyond the original remit!"
- Sister of Parvos: "You represent an embarrassing mistake. And what do we do with those, Sisters? We shred them."
- Sister of Parvos: "If I can face a disciplinary meeting with Sister Glarios, I can certainly face the likes of you!"
- Ryoku: "She has me. Find a way in, and take her out."
- Ryoku: "It was a trap. Do not worry about me. Get in here and kill Vena."
- Vena: "Slaughter! Carnage! Viscera! You are my gods!"
- Vena: "Blood for the Blood Queen! Me!"
- Vena: "Ahh... Haven't been stabbed like that... in a long time."
- Ryoku: "Vena will heal. She always does. Return to Pontis Tower and ready yourself for next time."
- Ryoku: "Vena's scars will fade, but her humiliation will endure."
- Ryoku: "Great and terrible Hunhow, the Wytch Vena has been subdued."
- Ryoku: "Passage requires command credentials. Find them."
- Ryoku: "So this is what she was hiding. A glorious void serpent."
- Ryoku: "Behold, the Orowyrm. Let's go for a ride."
- Ryoku: "You have done this before. Haven't you, Tenno? Take us to The Kuva Wytch."
- Ryoku: "There. Her capital ship. Steer. Find your target."
